selection_scope: first evidence investment only; no evidence-based claim of best paper success probability
reason: normal HERO future stripe window and concrete missing storage are already source-bound; one finite card can decide whether an interface/cost problem remains without first building a runtime or telemetry system
question: For one normal future B stripe, what residual remains after feasible ordinary prewarm/PTE-cache, and is there a concrete full-cost/deployment reason to retain a one-shot result outside IOTLB?

inputs.nearest_methods: ICCD2018 §IV-A/IV-C; DATE2025 PTE LLC; ATS/ATC prior verified scope
inputs.target_interface_sources: root-source-manifest.json: TC/PTW and existing debug path from prepare-resource source manifest
inputs.existing_result_reuse: Use only scoped evidence that actually applies; A5 AXPY is not this mm-large workload

one_case.program: HERO mm-large default normal A/B/C work, no added publisher or pressure
one_case.candidate_slice: s=0, compute B(0), prepare future B(2) before its SPM slot is legally reused/submitted in next iteration; confirm indices and last-use events from source before freezing
one_case.mapping: actual page granule/alignment not established; any 4KiB 4/5-page projection explicitly hypothetical and shared by every control; allow feasible large-page/contiguous alternatives
one_case.time: source order a/r available; duration and service parameters unknown until explicitly sourced/frozen; no fabricated cycle/deadline claim

deliverables: one-source-stripe-card with address generation, SPM release, actual native submit and complete-use ownership
ordinary residual card: warm/debug/PTE-cache/local-ATC availability, actual inputs versus projection assumptions; if residual cannot be established record why

storage/port/lifecycle table for best one-shot implementation (may be O-PAQ-D), O-PIN and feasible local ATC: all pending/ready/fault credits, context/permission/epoch/PPNs, source of storage, ports, ownership and last-use release
root decision: proceed to one specifically frozen implementation/model, redesign with an exact input gap, or end this evidence investment; no repeated six-family reranking by default
controls: existing debug prewarm with CPU/MMIO/rewalk/pollution cost
O-PIN with legitimate early unpin and same paid registration
O-PAQ-D same finite pool and field recycling; can be implementation rather than an imaginary extra opponent
feasible on-chip ATS/local ATC and normal physical-cache integration with same deployment/resource accounting

acceptance.proceed_only_if: source-reachable residual plus concrete capability/deployment/cost point survives the named controls; protocol owner and final consumer endpoint explicit
acceptance.not_required: native joint trace before every clearly labelled source projection; every imaginable ordinary program must fail; unique algorithm if contribution is a validated interface integration
end_this_version_if: ordinary permitted design already meets complete target without useful residual
same complete cost removes stated integration advantage
no legitimate finite storage/owner or normal source instance can be specified
acceptance.unknown_handling: lack of mapping/time/physical layout remains unknown; neither positive nor universal negative; list exact needed input without launching a collector automatically

scope: only card and bounded source/cost derivation first
no FPGA/native device/MIG; paused state persists
no old experiment rerun; M0 guard and raw data unchanged
do not start a large functional model just to reproduce the already expressible state machine
later source-bound model is possible when this evidence answers a concrete deciding question; user authorization is not retracted

other_candidates.I: not_ready; reentry requires normal legal sparse batch + live budget + frontend service evidence and correct ordinary layout controls
other_candidates.D_live: not promoted; new timely source-bound opportunity needed beyond these two COPY traces
other_candidates.A_G_Q_C2: specific results/questions preserved; no automatic fallback
